summary: Tested Bundle Deals feature comprehensively. All 25 backend tests passed (public endpoints, admin CRUD, validation rules). Frontend UI verified: Homepage shows Bundle Deals section with 2 active bundles (Accessory Essentials Rs.500 flat off, Complete Look Bundle 15% off), bundle cards link to detail pages. Bundle Detail Page shows products grid, pricing, 'Add Entire Bundle to Cart' button. PDP shows 'Part of a Bundle Deal' banner for products in bundles. Admin panel at /admin/bundles has Create Bundle button, form with product search, discount type toggles, and existing bundle management.
critical_code_review_comments: bundle_routes.py: Public GET /api/bundles correctly filters is_active=True and populates products with pricing calculation
bundle_routes.py: GET /api/bundles/for-product/{product_id} correctly finds bundles containing the product
bundle_routes.py: Admin endpoints properly protected with get_admin_user dependency
bundle_routes.py: Validation enforces min 2 products, max 6 products, percentage discount max 50%
BundleDeals.jsx: BundleDealsSection renders on homepage with 3-column product image grid
BundleDeals.jsx: ProductBundleBanner shows on PDP with bundle name, savings, and link to bundle detail
BundleDeals.jsx: BundleDetailPage has 'Add Entire Bundle to Cart' button that adds all products with one click
AdminBundlePanel.jsx: ProductPicker component with search functionality for adding products to bundle
AdminBundlePanel.jsx: Discount type toggles (percentage/flat) with live price preview
AdminBundlePanel.jsx: Bundle list shows Active/Inactive badges, product thumbnails, pricing, and action buttons (toggle, edit, delete)
